title: Personality Change in Psychotherapy
coreMove: Look for personality change as reorganization of self-contact, not as surface behavior polish.
sourcePressure: The chapter asks what actually changes in personality through psychotherapy and how such change should be understood. No split source sidecar exists for ch11; frozen TOC and book skeleton support the heading, part placement, and broad intent only, with no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating change as mood improvement, compliance, or a before-after makeover.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of personality change
